question_text: A learner says reciprocal translocation and meiotic crossing-over are the same process because both exchange DNA between chromosomes. Under the textbook descriptions, are the partners involved actually the same? Identify the chromosome or chromatid partners in each process, explain what a normal crossover changes in the genetic material that a gamete can receive, and state whether the reciprocal translocation described necessarily produces a net gain or loss of genetic information.
